test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Rina __pulled a long face__ since her husband had not bought her a diamond necklace on their anniversary.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option(3)** i.e. To look saddened.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"pulled a long face"** means to look visibly sad or disappointed. (उदास दिखना)

 
 
• **Example: **After hearing the bad news, he pulled a long face.
 
 
 
• **To look saddened** refers to the act of showing sadness or disappointment through one's facial expression. (उदास दिखना)
 
 
• **Example: **She pulled a long face when she found out she didn't get the job.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option(3)** i.e. To look saddened.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To be euphoric **(आनंदमय होना): To feel intense excitement or happiness.

 
 
• **Example:** She was euphoric when she won the lottery.
 
 
 
• **To be ecstatic **(प्रसन्नचित्त होना): To feel or express overwhelming happiness or joyful excitement.
 
 
• **Example: **He was ecstatic to hear that he had been promoted.
 
 
 
• **To be electrified** (उत्तेजित होना): To be thrilled or excited.
 
 
• **Example:** The crowd was electrified by the performance.
 
 

102:Tcfa,
The correct answer is **Option 4**
